name: Fake app build, deploy, and runtime failure injections
target: Injects deterministic app-development failures into one simulation world without calling build, deploy, or runtime services.
observations: build failures for missing static output and invalid app contract
deploy failures for publish-gate rejection, certificate issuance, and relay disconnect
runtime failures for repeated server errors, slow requests, rejected credentials, and canary hits
each injected record has a stage, connector, app ID, and app version
one unrecognized build-hook failure remains classified as unknown
